name: Underdark Crystal Cavern
description: Glowing fungi, violet crystal and black subterranean pools.
palette: black basalt, violet glow, cyan luminescence, pale mineral grey
lighting: bioluminescent crystal glow from below, cold rim light, deep shadow
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: uneven black rock shot through with pale mineral veins, wet and slick in the hollows and crusted with chalky mineral
materials: A vast underdark cavern of rough black stone. Uneven rock floor with mineral veins, jagged stalagmites, clusters of glowing violet and cyan crystal growing out of the rock around the edges of the floor, luminescent mushrooms in soft blue and green, still black subterranean pools reflecting the glow, chalky mineral deposits and scattered scree.
boundary: sheer natural rock closing the cave in, its face broken and irregular, streaked pale with mineral
